title: Firm or Rough Savings
subtitle: The Savings Journal now marks each saving as firm (real prices) or rough (a guess), and the total says how much of each.
intro: The code reaches your Sheet on its own. One **Upgrade workbook** adds a column, **Estimate**, at the right end of the Savings Journal on the To-Do & Reminders tab.
**Firm** means real prices, like a subscription you cancelled. **Rough** means a guess, like how many bags or loads you use in a year. A row left blank counts as rough.
The green total line under the category table now reads, for example, **about $500 a year (about $42 a month; $300 firm, $200 rough)**.
If you already ran the House & money plan upgrade, this one covers it too. **What does not change:** your entries and every other tab.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before savings estimate 2026-11-28`.
Reload the Sheet. Check that **Build Script Version** on the **App Setup** tab reads `1.47.0` (or later).
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.done: The report finishes without errors and lists the added column **Estimate** on To-Do & Reminders.

steps.text: Tell Claude the upgrade is done.
steps.done: Claude marks your entries: the subscriptions Firm; the bags, detergent and hair oil Rough.

steps.text: Open **To-Do & Reminders** and look at the green total line under **Estimated Savings by Category**.
steps.done: It shows the yearly total with how much is firm and how much is rough.

steps.text: For a new entry, pick **Firm** or **Rough** in the Estimate column.
steps.done: The split in the total line updates.
